summary: Vision Marine Technologies Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on April 27, 2026, announcing it has received conditional approval to list its common shares on the TSX Venture Exchange. The filing includes a press release detailing the additional listing, which is expected to complement its existing Nasdaq listing and expand capital markets access for Canadian investors. No specific terms, dates, or structural details for the listing are provided beyond the conditional approval. The company has an at-the-market equity program. This is a routine listing event, not a special situation.
